Maya: Heads-up — we just got two new open-model intake packages attached: `garnet-3b` and `tungsten-7b`. Can owners surface any immediate blockers for cataloging/licensing/perf?

Raj: I can take inference ownership for tungsten. Quick note: no perf profile for >8k context yet. Need a long-context run.

Serena: I’ll own licensing checks for garnet. @Claudia can you confirm whether garnet’s Apache2 + extra model-weight-redistribution clause is OK?

Claudia: Saw the package. The extra clause is unusual — I need the source manifest + model weights provenance before sign-off. Please upload to the legal intake drive: https://redwood.internal/legal/models/garnet-3b

Maya: Uploaded manifest and training data provenance links in the intake item. @Raj — for tungsten, perf gap is for prefix lengths >8k, right?

Raj: Correct. Short-run numbers (2k tokens) look fine: 18ms/token on p4d, batch=8. But we don't have 16k/32k runs. Can someone spin a long-context perf? Example command we used:
```bash
python perf/run.py --model tungsten-7b --context 16384 --batch 1 --iter 50 --device cuda
```

Luis: I can run that on Dedicated QC pool but need a quantized artifact first. Tungsten upstream only provided fp16. Any QAT/quant artifacts?

Raj: No quant yet. Roadmap item: get a q4_0 and q8_0 export. @Jen can help validate quality after quant.

Jen: Yep, I’ll run evals on the quant outputs once available. Can you drop the eval prompt set in the intake? Prefer small seedable set for regression checks (5–10 prompts).

Maya: Done — added a minimal promptset under intake/evals/tungsten_seeded.json and a longer regen set for 16k scenarios.

Claudia: For garnet licensing, I checked the manifest — weights provenance OK but we need CLA signature from upstream contributor. Serena, can you follow up?

Serena: On it. Will ping their repo lead and loop @Claudia. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Luis: If we decide to run long-context perf on Dedicated, note there’s a quota for the week. I can reserve 4h slot tomorrow morning. Who should I cc for priority?

Maya: CC @Raj and @Jen. If legal is still pending for garnet, we hold that model from public catalog but can perf tungsten.

Raj: I’ll queue the perf run. @Luis please start with context=16384, batch=1, token_len_distr set to long-tail. If p4d run is flaky, fallback to p4de.

deploy-bot: CI | model-intake pipeline started for tungsten-7b (build 3421). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/model-intake/3421

Jen: Quick QA ask — when quant artifacts are produced, include a deterministic seed and example KV-cache-size note. That helps reproduce reg checks.

Maya: Agree. Action items recap: 1) Raj — perf long-run for tungsten (Luis reserved slot) 2) Luis — generate reserved run and attach logs 3) Jen — run quality evals on quant outputs 4) Serena/Claudia — finalize garnet license CLA. I’ll update intake status to "in-flight".

Raj: I'll open a short PR with perf scripts and expected metrics so infra can compare. Ping me for CR.

Serena: If CLA clears earlier, we can do a quick canary for garnet in staging. Otherwise hold.

Maya: Thanks all — will post final status here after perf + legal. :thumbsup:
